description_en: Continues the deployment of a service instance after a deployment failure. You must specify the region ID, service ID, and the configuration parameters for the service instance
description_zh: 服务实例部署失败后，通过指定地域ID、服务ID、服务实例配置参数，继续部署服务实例
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier continue-deploy-service-instance --service-instance-id si-0e6fca6a51a544200000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ContinueDeployServiceInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service instance
parameters.name: service_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration parameters of the service instance
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for the request. The dry run checks for permissions, the instance status, and other items. Valid values:

true: Sends a dry run request. The deployment of the service instance does not continue.

false: Sends a regular request. The deployment of the service instance continues after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。可能的值：

true：发送请求，不创建服务实例。

false：发送请求，检查通过后创建服务实例
parameters.name: dry_run

DryRunResult.description_en: The result of the dry run
